title: Report switches on Format in two places and must be edited for every new format

must_find.why: adding a format means opening Report and editing a working method instead of adding an exporter type
the same Format discriminator is switched on a second time; polymorphism belongs here
format is a selector argument that picks which of two behaviours runs

must_not_find.why: csv and json share no lines; the duplication is the repeated switch, cited under G23
